---
title: "Price Framing, Discount Anchoring, and Social Proof on Purchase Intent"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(car)       # Type III ANOVA
library(ggplot2)
data <- read.csv("Earbuds_Combined.csv")
data$Framing <- factor(data$Framing)
data$Anchor  <- factor(data$Anchor)
data$Reviews <- factor(data$Reviews)
```

## Data summary

```{r summary}
table(data$Version)
aggregate(Rating ~ Framing + Anchor + Reviews, data = data,
          FUN = function(x) c(n = length(x), mean = round(mean(x), 2), sd = round(sd(x), 2)))
```

## Three-way ANOVA (with interactions)

Cell counts are unequal, so Type III sums of squares with sum-to-zero contrasts are used.

```{r anova}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
model <- lm(Rating ~ Framing * Anchor * Reviews, data = data)
Anova(model, type = 3)
```

## Interaction graphs

```{r interaction, message=FALSE}
means <- aggregate(Rating ~ Anchor + Reviews, data = data, FUN = mean)
ggplot(means, aes(Anchor, Rating, color = Reviews, group = Reviews)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Anchor x Reviews interaction", y = "Mean purchase intent (1-7)")

means3 <- aggregate(Rating ~ Framing + Anchor + Reviews, data = data, FUN = mean)
ggplot(means3, aes(Anchor, Rating, color = Reviews, group = Reviews)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~ Framing) +
  labs(y = "Mean purchase intent (1-7)")
```

## Assumption checks

```{r assumptions}
leveneTest(Rating ~ Framing * Anchor * Reviews, data = data)
shapiro.test(residuals(model))
plot(model, which = 1:2)
```
